title: Restructure Issue Sweep
eyebrow: Sweep · close the earlier restructure (#306) and its 9 open steps as replaced by the plugin split (#437)

short.lead: A sweep page lists issues to close, each with its evidence, for your approval. Choice 3A on the plugin split build plan closes the earlier restructure, "Restructure into a shared core with project boundaries and six optional sub-plugins" (#306), as replaced by "Split house-rules into nine plugins and a shared library" (#437). The close guard, the check that refuses a close without proof, refused my first try because a not-planned close needs a sweep you approve here. This page closes 10 issues: #306 and its open steps #341, #343 to #349 and #381. Two open sub-issues of #306 are not part of the split and stay open: the Unity prefab and scene map (#334) and keeping work saved through a usage limit (#406).
